source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-37

procedures.title: Power cylinder (Corvette): remove, inspect and install
steps: Disassembly: take out the snap ring and pull the rod out to remove the piston rod seal, taking care not to spray oil.
Remove the rod scraper, scraper element, backup washer and rod seal from the rod.
At the ball stud end, remove the ball stud seal.
Remove the snap ring holding the end plug with the lube fitting.
Push on the ball stud end and remove the end plug, spring, spring seat and ball stud.
Remove the O-ring from the top lip of the ball stud opening.
To replace the ball seat, press it out with tool J-8937.
Assembly: reassemble the rod seal parts in reverse order, first coating the seal and scraper inner faces thinly with Lubriplate or equivalent.
Reassemble the ball stud parts in reverse order.
Make sure each snap ring is fully seated in its groove.
Installation: install in reverse of removal.
Reconnect the 2 hydraulic lines, fill with fluid, bleed out air as under Maintenance and Adjustments, and grease the ball joint.
notes: See figure 65 in the manual for the exploded view.

procedures.title: Power steering hoses: install
steps: Route the hoses in their correct positions as shown in figure 67 in the manual.
